A3211 Victoria Embankment way/236139546 width=7; Bridge Street way/406370787 destination:lanes:backward; shoulder=no on 9 primary ways
read for lane and surface tags; nothing in this sheet depends on it alone

sources.tile_scale: 8 m to a 16 px tile, from tools/osm_to_map.py METRES_PER_TILE
sources.odbl_line_written_by: this file's own odbl key, above, verbatim

odbl_note: the tile geometry (corridor width, lane width, line and dash lengths) is derived from those extracts at 8 m per tile, so the class file and the map built from it carry the line above verbatim; the game's own art and story do not
rule: every tile in assets/tiles/drive/drive_tiles.png appears here once, by index and by name, with walkable true or false and the reason; a tile missing from this file cannot be placed by the map wiring
not_walkable_rule: a tile is not walkable when it is a solid (a post, a barrier, a hedge) or when it is ground you cannot stand on because something is over it (a sign, a beam)
